need_own_app.answer: Managed OAuth exists for prototypes. For a production multi-customer product you need your own Greenhouse partner credentials to remove Composio branding, get dedicated quota and control scopes.

prerequisites.title: Signed partnership agreement
prerequisites.detail: Fill out the integration request form first; credential steps start only after the agreement is finalized.

prerequisites.title: Credential request details
prerequisites.detail: Prepare integration name, scopes, redirect URI(s), environment and a 128x128 logo.

steps.title: Submit integration request form
steps.detail: Apply to the Greenhouse partner program and sign the partnership agreement.

steps.title: Wait for monthly partner review
steps.detail: Requests are reviewed on the first Monday monthly; Greenhouse replies within 7 business days.

steps.title: Prepare credential request
steps.detail: Draft the integration name, minimal scope list, redirect URI(s) and logo checklist.

steps.title: Email Partner Support for credentials
steps.detail: Request testing credentials first, then production; send the final redirect URI once tested.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom auth config with your Client ID and secret, using the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and a test connection works.

steps.title: Create credentials in Greenhouse
steps.detail: Open API Credentials, create new credentials as Harvest V3 (OAuth), then configure scopes.

traps.title: The page does not describe any review or verification
traps.detail: The page does not describe any review or verification checks or submission requirements.

traps.title: Refresh token expires after 14 days unused
traps.detail: If unused for 14 days the user must repeat the full authorization flow. Access tokens last 1 hour and authorization codes 1 minute.

traps.title: Unregistered redirect URI is rejected
traps.detail: The redirect URI must match the one registered with Greenhouse, and changes need Partner Support.

traps.title: Scopes outside your grant fail
traps.detail: Requesting scopes not permitted for your client gives invalid_scope; scope changes go through Partner Support.

traps.title: Authorizing user's permissions matter
traps.detail: Calls can fail with 403 if the authorizing user lacks in-app permissions. Some endpoints, including list endpoints, need a Site Admin authorizing user.

blockers.symptom: Monthly review cadence delays your launch
blockers.what_it_means: Partner requests are reviewed once a month.
blockers.what_to_do: Apply early; ask for an out-of-cycle review only for urgent mutual-customer needs.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the request email to partneronboarding@greenhouse.io.
